parameters.query: WITH existing_message AS (SELECT * FROM social_media.messages WHERE channel=$1 AND external_message_id=$2 LIMIT 1), inserted_message AS (INSERT INTO social_media.messages(correlation_id,channel,external_message_id,direction,sender_id,body,raw_payload) SELECT $6::uuid,$1,$2,'INBOUND',$3,$4,$5::jsonb WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM existing_message) RETURNING *), selected_message AS (SELECT * FROM inserted_message UNION ALL SELECT * FROM existing_message WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted_message)), inserted_event AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT m.correlation_id,NULL,'MESSAGE_RECEIVED','01 - Orquestrador - Entrada ate Conteudo',jsonb_build_object('message_id',m.message_id,'channel',m.channel,'sender_id',m.sender_id) FROM inserted_message m RETURNING event_id) SELECT m.message_id,m.correlation_id,m.channel,m.external_message_id,m.sender_id,m.body AS message,m.raw_payload,$7::text AS requested_client_id,true AS demo_mode,false AS live_mode,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted_message) AS is_duplicate,(SELECT content_id FROM social_media.content_items WHERE source_message_id=m.message_id ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1) AS existing_content_id FROM selected_message m;

WITH created AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.content_items (
    client_id, source_message_id, request, briefing, caption, image_prompt,
    title, subtitle, cta, hashtags, visual_description, assembly_instructions,
    automatic_response, ai_provider, ai_model, structured_output, status
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2::uuid, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5, $6,
    $7, $8, $9, $10::jsonb, $11, $12::jsonb,
    $15, $13, $14, $16::jsonb, 'BRIEFING_CREATED'
  )
  RETURNING *
), version_created AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.content_versions (content_id, version, briefing, copy)
  SELECT content_id, 1, briefing,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'title', title, 'subtitle', subtitle, 'cta', cta,
      'caption', caption, 'hashtags', hashtags,
      'visual_description', visual_description,
      'image_prompt', image_prompt,
      'assembly_instructions', assembly_instructions
    )
  FROM created
  RETURNING version_label
), outbound_message AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.messages (
    correlation_id, client_id, channel, direction, sender_id, body, raw_payload
  )
  SELECT $19::uuid, $1, $17, 'OUTBOUND', 'social-media-ai-agent', $15,
         jsonb_build_object('content_id', content_id, 'provider', $13, 'model', $14)
  FROM created
  RETURNING message_id
), operation_created AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.external_operations (
    content_id, operation_type, provider, model, prompt, external_id, cost_estimate, status, response_metadata
  )
  SELECT content_id, 'TEXT_GENERATION', $13, $14, $3::text, $20, $22::numeric, 'SUCCESS',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'structured_output', true,
           'usage', $21::jsonb,
           'pricing_usd_per_million', jsonb_build_object('input', 0.25, 'cached_input', 0.025, 'output', 2.00)
         )
  FROM created
  RETURNING operation_id, external_id, cost_estimate, response_metadata
), events_created AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.events (
    correlation_id, client_id, content_id, event_type, workflow_name, details
  )
  SELECT $19::uuid, $1, c.content_id, e.event_type,
         '01 - Orquestrador - Entrada ate Conteudo', e.details
  FROM created c
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES
    ('AI_CALLED', jsonb_build_object('provider', $13, 'model', $14, 'response_id', $20, 'usage', $21::jsonb, 'cost_estimate_usd', $22::numeric)),
    ('INTENT_INTERPRETED', $3::jsonb),
    ('AUTOMATIC_RESPONSE_CREATED', jsonb_build_object('response', $15)),
    ('BRIEFING_CREATED', $4::jsonb),
    ('CONTENT_GENERATED', jsonb_build_object('title', $7, 'version', 1))
  ) AS e(event_type, details)
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT
  c.content_id, c.client_id, c.source_message_id AS message_id,
  c.status, c.approval_status, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cta,
  c.caption, c.hashtags, c.image_prompt, c.visual_description,
  c.assembly_instructions, c.automatic_response, c.ai_provider, c.ai_model,
  c.briefing, c.request AS intent, c.structured_output,
  (SELECT version_label FROM version_created LIMIT 1) AS version_label,
  (SELECT message_id FROM outbound_message LIMIT 1) AS outbound_message_id,
  (SELECT external_id FROM operation_created LIMIT 1) AS ai_response_id,
  (SELECT response_metadata->'usage' FROM operation_created LIMIT 1) AS ai_usage,
  (SELECT cost_estimate FROM operation_created LIMIT 1) AS ai_cost_estimate_usd,
  true AS persisted, true AS demo_mode, false AS external_actions_executed
FROM created c;
